mediaplayer.editor.title: Media HUD Editor
mediaplayer.editor.hint: Drag to move, scroll to scale, R to reset the position, arrow keys to nudge
mediaplayer.config.title: Media Player
mediaplayer.config.enabled.description: Show the media HUD while playing.
mediaplayer.config.layout.description: Full shows everything stacked. Compact fits everything into a single row.
mediaplayer.config.open_editor.descripti: Drag the HUD to any position and scroll to change its scale.
mediaplayer.config.width.description: Width of the HUD before scaling.
mediaplayer.config.scale.description: Size of the HUD on screen.
mediaplayer.config.group.visibility.desc: When the HUD should hide itself.
mediaplayer.config.hide_when_nothing_pla: Hide the HUD when no app reports any media.
mediaplayer.config.hide_when_paused.desc: Hide the HUD after the media has been paused for a while.
mediaplayer.config.hide_when_paused_dela: How long the media has to be paused before the HUD hides.
mediaplayer.config.show_title.descriptio: Show the title of the track.
mediaplayer.config.show_album.descriptio: Show the album name. Only used by the full layout.
mediaplayer.config.show_progress_bar.des: Show how far the track is. Click or drag it while chat is open to seek.
mediaplayer.config.show_timestamps.descr: Show the current position and length of the track.
mediaplayer.config.show_controls.descrip: Show the previous, play/pause and next buttons. Click them while chat or an inventory is open.
mediaplayer.config.show_volume.descripti: Show the volume of the playing app. Click the icon to mute, drag the slider or scroll over the HUD to change it.
mediaplayer.config.theme.description: A color preset for the whole HUD. Changing a color afterwards switches this to Custom.
mediaplayer.config.background_gradient.d: Fade the background from the background color into a second color.
mediaplayer.config.background_gradient_e: The color the background fades into.
mediaplayer.config.accent_gradient.descr: Fade the progress and volume bars from the accent color into a second color.
mediaplayer.config.accent_gradient_end.d: The color the bars fade into.
mediaplayer.config.show_background.descr: Draw a background behind the HUD.
mediaplayer.config.background_color.desc: Color and opacity of the background.
Color of the artist, album and timestamps.
mediaplayer.config.accent_color.descript: Color of the filled part of the progress bar, volume slider and hovered buttons.
mediaplayer.config.track_color.descripti: Color of the empty part of the progress bar and volume slider.
mediaplayer.config.icon_color.descriptio: Color of the playback and volume buttons.
mediaplayer.config.rounded_corners.descr: Round the corners of the background and bars.
mediaplayer.config.corner_radius.descrip: How round the background, bars and buttons are.
mediaplayer.config.scroll_long_text.desc: Scroll text that does not fit instead of cutting it off.
